name: soko-os
description: Soko-OS: The Operating System for African Businesses

scripts.test: pnpm test:packages && pnpm test:frontend && pnpm test:backend
scripts.test:backend: docker compose exec -T backend php artisan test
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose exec -T web pnpm test:e2e
scripts.dev:reset: echo 'DESTRUCTIVE: removing containers and volumes' && docker compose down -v
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T backend php artisan migrate --force
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T backend php artisan db:seed --force
scripts.db:reset: echo 'DESTRUCTIVE: migrate:fresh --seed' && docker compose exec -T backend php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force
